title: diphylleia cymosa subsp. grayi
intro: Diphylleia cymosa subsp. grayi, commonly known as Gray's umbrella plant, is a perennial plant species in the barberry family (Berberidaceae). This plant is valued for its unique umbrella-like leaves that open and close with changes in humidity, and it is traditionally used in herbal medicine. The health benefits of Gray's umbrella plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which are said to help alleviate respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Diphylleia cymosa subsp. grayi include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, attributed to bioactive constituents like alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds.
